description: Test suite for the app client using pytest. Contains setup for environment, client fixture, and test cases for health check and artifact retrieval.

methods.name: _prepare_env
methods.description: Sets up environment variable COREDOC_ARTIFACTS with a path to artifacts.json within a temporary directory.

methods.name: client
methods.description: Pytest fixture that initializes a test client for the app, after setting up environment variables.

methods.name: test_health
methods.description: Tests the /health endpoint for a 200 status and status 'ok' in JSON response.

methods.name: test_artifacts_store_and_retrieve
methods.description: Tests POST /artifacts and GET /artifacts endpoints for correct status codes and JSON response types.
